notes: Automates Contracts Back funding completion for both UFS and TruPath. Each Contracts refresh checks active contract deal statuses through the correct account's LendTech API. Funded deals are matched to the original Funding Email in the same account; the sender assigns Working By and the row moves to Funded. If no matching email is found, the row moves to the new Funded - uncertain section. Manual completed statuses and existing worker assignments are preserved.
